description: This file contains server-side logic for the Admin Panel page of an online examination system, handling navigation between different pages through button click event handlers.

classes.name: AdminPanel
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminPanel ASP.NET page, managing navigation events.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently does not contain any logic.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the 'home' button click; currently empty.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers server execution to the AdminQueue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers server execution to the AdminLeaderboard page.

methods.name: sExamB_Click
methods.description: Transfers server execution to the SetExam page.

methods.name: eExamB_Click
methods.description: Transfers server execution to the EditExam page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers server execution to the LoginPage (logout).
